changes.summary: Lite's tab icon is inverted: a black wing on a white square
Lite gets quicker: book the earliest, home and recent places, the rest of the trip, firmer prices
Lite's wait creeps steadily, and requests can name an aircraft or a need the data cannot check
Lite keeps airports out of the trip when asked, and shows a wing and progress bar while it works
Lite's flights open a "More details" panel with the aircraft, on-time record and more
Lite centres the example chips under the "Anything else?" box
Lite's option headings sit on the same line as their choices
Lite's options read Trip, Leaving, Cabin, Travellers, Bags, with bold headings
Lite keeps every option label, and Leaving matches the others' size in bold
Lite's options sit on one centred line under the box, with bullets between
Lite puts Leaving in the centre, in bold, with Today, Tomorrow or a date
Lite shows earliest arrival and cheapest side by side, and opens a flight in place
Lite asks "Anything else?" as it searches, and the options sit on one line
ConcordeGo Lite asks one thing: where you need to be, and gets you there now
Lite centres the date on a one-way trip, and four layout sketches at /lite/mock
ConcordeGo Lite opens on a round trip, with the options on top and each date under its place
ConcordeGo Lite is lighter and simpler: big fields, the options tucked below
ConcordeGo Lite: three good flights from one short search, at /lite
